observed_issue: The San test page failed before rendering with: [SAN ERROR] ROOT>section>div>aside>small>option is closed with button.
root_cause: All five migrated loops emitted trackby as a separate unquoted attribute, for example s-for="item in cycles" trackby item. San requires the tracking expression inside the s-for value, for example s-for="item in cycles trackby item". The malformed attributes confused the template parser and produced a misleading tag-closing error. The formal_30_v1 final static validation reported passed despite this syntax, so this is also a validator false negative.
fix: The v2 copy moves each tracking expression inside its s-for value for cycles, unassigned work, member lanes, lane items, and change-log entries. The repaired template was compiled with the locally installed San package. The frozen formal_30_v1 artifact remains unchanged.
manual_checks: Initial title, cycle, total points, unassigned items, member lanes, loads, capacity bars, and save state match Vue.
Selecting a work item updates its selected style and current-work details.
Assigning an item moves it to the selected member lane and updates load, capacity bar, save state, and log.
Unassigning an item returns it to the pool without unintended parent-button selection behavior.
Increasing and decreasing capacity updates the denominator, capacity bar, near-limit or overloaded style, and unsaved state.
Cycle switching and skill filtering show the correct work and member subsets.
Saving restores the saved state and appends the expected log entry.
